item.title: [翻译] Lenny's Newsletter: 半数产品经理的困境
item.description:
标签: #产品经理 #AI变革 #职业转型 #行业趋势

摘要: 前Meta与Google产品高管Nikhyl Singhal预测，未来两年将是产品经理行业最混乱的时期，随着企业以"AI优先"标准大规模重组团队，约半数传统产品经理将面临淘汰风险。他认为，在这场变革中，简历上的大厂光环已不再重要，能否突破心理障碍、主动拥抱AI工具并找到与AI协作的"乐趣"，将决定从业者能否在新时代立足。

原标题: Why half of product managers are in trouble | Nikhyl Singhal (Meta, Google)

Why half of product managers are in trouble | Nikhyl Singhal (Meta, Google)

Nikhyl Singhal is the founder of The Skip, a community for senior product leaders; a former product exec at Meta, Google, and Credit Karma; and a many-time founder. He’s also one of the most honest, unfiltered voices on what’s actually happening in product management right now.

Nikhyl Singhal 是 The Skip 的创始人——这是一个面向资深产品负责人的社群；他曾在 Meta、Google 和 Credit Karma 担任产品高管，并且多次创业。他也是当下对 product management（产品管理）领域真实状况最坦诚、最不加掩饰的发声者之一。

Listen on YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts

在 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple Podcasts 上收听

In our in-depth conversation, we discuss:

在我们深入的对话中，我们讨论了：

  • Why the next two years will be the most chaotic period in product management history
  • Why half of current product managers are at risk, and what separates those who’ll do well
  • Why you need to find your “moments of joy” with AI
  • The “smiling exhaustion” he’s seeing across the product community
  • The psychological barriers that prevent people from reinventing themselves
  • Why your resume’s fancy logos matter less than ever, and what matters now
  • His prediction that companies will shed 30,000 people and rehire 8,000—all AI-first

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 个人AI时代的全面无头化
item.description:
标签: #无头服务 #个人AI #API优先

摘要: 文章指出，无头化服务通过API为个人AI提供了比图形界面更高效、可靠的交互方式；随着Salesforce等企业推动“API即UI”战略，API正成为产品的核心竞争优势，并可能颠覆传统SaaS按人头计费的商业模式。

原标题: Headless everything for personal AI

Headless everything for personal AI

个人 AI 的全面无头化（Headless）

Why? Because using personal AIs is a better experience for users than using services directly (honestly); and headless services are quicker and more dependable for the personal AIs than having them click round a GUI with a bot-controlled mouse.

为什么？因为对用户而言，使用个人 AI（personal AI）比直接使用服务体验更好（说实话）；而且无头服务（headless services）对个人 AI 来说更快、更可靠，远胜于让它们操控机器人鼠标在图形用户界面（GUI）上点按。

Why? Because using personal AIs is a better experience for users than using services directly (honestly); and headless services are quicker and more dependable for the personal AIs than having them click round a GUI with a bot-controlled mouse.

为什么？因为对用户而言，使用个人 AI（personal AI）比直接使用服务体验更好（说实话）；而且无头服务（headless services）对个人 AI 来说更快、更可靠，远胜于让它们操控机器人鼠标在图形用户界面（GUI）上点按。

EvidentlyMarc Benioff thinks so too:

显然，Marc Benioff 也这么认为：

Welcome Salesforce Headless 360: No Browser Required! Our API is the UI. Entire Salesforce & Agentforce & Slack platforms are now exposed as APIs, MCP, & CLI. All AI agents can access data, workflows, and tasks directly in Slack, Voice, or anywhere else with Salesforce Headless.

欢迎 Salesforce Headless 360：无需浏览器！我们的 API 就是 UI。整个 Salesforce、Agentforce 和 Slack 平台现在均以 API、MCP 和 CLI 的形式对外暴露。所有 AI 智能体（AI agents）均可通过 Salesforce Headless 直接在 Slack、Voice 或任何其他地方访问数据、工作流和任务。

Welcome Salesforce Headless 360: No Browser Required! Our API is the UI. Entire Salesforce & Agentforce & Slack platforms are now exposed as APIs, MCP, & CLI. All AI agents can access data, workflows, and tasks directly in Slack, Voice, or anywhere else with Salesforce Headless.

欢迎 Salesforce Headless 360：无需浏览器！我们的 API 就是 UI。整个 Salesforce、Agentforce 和 Slack 平台现在均以 API、MCP 和 CLI 的形式对外暴露。所有 AI 智能体（AI agents）均可通过 Salesforce Headless 直接在 Slack、Voice 或任何其他地方访问数据、工作流和任务。

If this feed does take off it's going to play havoc with existing per-head SaaS pricing schemes.

如果这一趋势（feed）真的起飞，现有的按人头（per-head）SaaS 定价模式将遭受严重冲击。

I'm reminded of the early 2010s era when every online service was launching APIs. Brandur Leach reminisces about that time in The Second Wave of the API-first Economy, and predicts that APIs are ready to make a comeback:

这让我想起了 2010 年代初，当时每个在线服务都在推出 API。Brandur Leach 在《API-first Economy 的第二波浪潮》（The Second Wave of the API-first Economy）中回忆了那个时代，并预测 API 即将卷土重来：

Suddenly, an API is no longer liability, but a major saleable vector to give users what they want: a way into the services they use and pay for so that an agent can carry out work on their behalf. Especially given a field of relatively undifferentiated products, in the near future the availability of an API might just be the crucial deciding factor that leads to one choice winning the field.

突然间，API 不再是一种负担（liability），而是一个重要的可销售向量（saleable vector），旨在为用户提供他们想要的东西：一条通往他们使用和付费的服务的通道，以便让智能体（agent）代表他们完成工作。尤其是在产品同质化较为严重的领域，在不久的将来，API 的可用性很可能成为决定某一选择胜出的关键因素。
